patch_description: This edit implements the recommended Gen 45 × Gen 46 composition: (a) the 3-scale SG kernel bank uses half-widths [sg_half//2, sg_half, 2·sg_half] with Gaussian volatility membership centered at the 20/50/80th percentiles, with explicit guards against degenerate percentile denominators (spread could be zero or negative when volatility is flat, which would produce NaN weights — the exact failure mode that zeroed Gen 66); and (b) the trend lead gate uses the pure RTS smoother slope channel (already in the current code) with an added output-shape validation after each stage. The wider 2·sg_half kernel deepens noise reduction in calm regions (improving noise_reduction and slope_changes), while the shorter sg_half//2 kernel keeps responsiveness in volatile regions (lag_error), targeting the untried Pareto point between the two 0.65 anchors.
